
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaozhi_5638/p/19361189" title="发布于 2025-12-17 11:26">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">一个完全由大模型AI Coding开发而成的程序员工具网站</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>这本来是一个我出于好奇，测试大模型能力的试验性工作，做到最后发现完全可以落地实用，于是扩容了原来的云服务器和域名，将网站上线。现将本网站详细信息、以及开发过程和思路分享给大家：</p>
<p><strong>网站地址</strong>：<a href="http://tools.zhzhi.cool/" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="text-decoration: underline"><span style="font-family: Calibri">http://tools.zhzhi.cool/</span></span></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体"><br></span></p>
<p><strong>网站介绍：</strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">程序员常用工具集合，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">IP</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">查询</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/JSON</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">格式化</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">文本</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Diff</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">工具</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">二维码生成</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">取色板等等（新工具后面陆续上线），点击网站查看更多工具</span></p>
<p><strong>开发工具</strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">：</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">VS Code + Chrome</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">浏览器 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">+ ChatGPT/Claude</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">大模型（</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Copilot</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">插件</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/Web Chat</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">）</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">+ Qwen</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">大模型（</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Web Chat/</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">通义灵码插件）</span></p>
<p><strong>技术栈：</strong><span style="font-family: Calibri">Python + FastAPI + </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">原生</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">HTML/JS/CSS</span></p>
<p><strong>开发分工：</strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">本网站全部代码（含前</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">后端）完全由大模型</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">AI Coding</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">生成，作者只负责提示词编写，以及部分效果调试，外加云服务器购买、域名购买备案。</span></p>
<p><strong>作者背景：</strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">了解</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Python</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，了解</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">HTML/JS/CSS</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，不会任何前端框架。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>下面是目前上线的工具介绍：</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Calibri">0</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span>首页截图</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/104032/202512/104032-20251217114652726-1730181954.png" alt="0" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Calibri">1</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">IP</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">域名地址查询</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">链接：</span><a href="http://tools.zhzhi.cool/iptool" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="font-family: Calibri">http://tools.zhzhi.cool/iptool</span></a></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">功能：查询</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">IP</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">和域名归属地，基于免费</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">API</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">完全前端实现。</span></p>
<p>截图：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/104032/202512/104032-20251217111753548-1408280855.jpg" alt="1" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Calibri">2</span>、代码截图工具</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">链接：</span><a href="http://tools.zhzhi.cool/code2imgtool" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="font-family: Calibri">http://tools.zhzhi.cool/code2imgtool</span></a></p>
<p>功能：输入代码片段，生成炫酷的代码图片。</p>
<p>截图：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/104032/202512/104032-20251217111811497-37414815.jpg" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>3、<span style="font-family: 宋体">文本</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">diff</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">工具</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">链接：</span><a href="http://tools.zhzhi.cool/difftool" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="font-family: Calibri">http://tools.zhzhi.cool/difftool</span></a></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">功能：输入两段文本，高亮差异（支持字符</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">词</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">行</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/Patch</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">模式）</span></p>
<p>截图：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/104032/202512/104032-20251217111827764-1922350570.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>4、<span style="font-family: Calibri">Emoji</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">字符工具</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">链接：</span><a href="http://tools.zhzhi.cool/emojitool" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="font-family: Calibri">http://tools.zhzhi.cool/emojitool</span></a></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">功能：收集</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">3000</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">多个常用</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">emoji</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">字符，快速拷贝</span></p>
<p>截图：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/104032/202512/104032-20251217111841341-2051069186.jpg" alt="4" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>5、<span style="font-family: Calibri">JSON</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">格式化工具</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">链接：</span><a href="http://tools.zhzhi.cool/jsontool" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="font-family: Calibri">http://tools.zhzhi.cool/jsontool</span></a></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">功能：</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">JSON</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">格式化，快速复制</span></p>
<p>截图：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/104032/202512/104032-20251217111903561-635952665.png" alt="5" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>6、<span style="font-family: Calibri">XML</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">格式化工具</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">链接：</span><a href="http://tools.zhzhi.cool/xmltool" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="font-family: Calibri">http://tools.zhzhi.cool/xmltool</span></a></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">功能：</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">XML</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">格式化，快速复制</span></p>
<p>截图：</p>
<p>&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/104032/202512/104032-20251217111913284-1759433101.png" alt="6" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>7、图片瘦身工具</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">链接：</span><a href="http://tools.zhzhi.cool/compressiontool" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="font-family: Calibri">http://tools.zhzhi.cool/compressiontool</span></a></p>
<p>功能：图片格式转换、文件体积压缩</p>
<p>截图：</p>
<p>&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/104032/202512/104032-20251217111922583-665242193.jpg" alt="7" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>8、二维码工具</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">链接：</span><a href="http://tools.zhzhi.cool/qrcodetool" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="font-family: Calibri">http://tools.zhzhi.cool/qrcodetool</span></a></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">功能：二维码识别（图片</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">-&gt;</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">文本）、二维码生成（文本</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">-&gt;</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">图片）</span></p>
<p>截图：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/104032/202512/104032-20251217111940830-708165486.jpg" alt="8" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>9、正则匹配工具</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">链接：</span><a href="http://tools.zhzhi.cool/regextool" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="font-family: Calibri">http://tools.zhzhi.cool/regextool</span></a></p>

<p align="justify">10、<span style="font-family: 宋体">图片</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">base64</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">编解码工具</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">链接：</span><a href="http://tools.zhzhi.cool/base64tool" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="font-family: Calibri">http://tools.zhzhi.cool/base64tool</span></a></p>

<p>11、取色工具</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">链接：</span><a href="http://tools.zhzhi.cool/colortool" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="font-family: Calibri">http://tools.zhzhi.cool/colortool</span></a></p>
